section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section presents findings from a single study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women examining body appreciation (BA), body weight satisfaction, and weight loss efforts. The study found that women had low BA (mean 3.92±2.43) and high obesity rates (55% classified obese, mean BMI 29.64±5.82), with 80% attempting weight loss. BA was negatively correlated with BMI, consistent with findings in Western and non-Western populations, suggesting BA is a modifiable factor in weight control among middle-aged women.

section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section presents findings from a single study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women examining body appreciation (BA), body weight satisfaction, and weight loss efforts. The study found that women had low BA (mean 3.92±2.43) and high obesity rates (55% classified as obese with mean BMI 29.64±5.82), with 69.9% reporting body dissatisfaction and 78.5% attempting weight loss. The text notes that BA was negatively correlated with BMI and discusses various motivations for weight loss, including health concerns (34%), appearance (20%), and sexuality (17.2%).
